title: N -W F P Local Government Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT X OF 1996
ACT X OF 1996
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th August, 1996]
No.PA/N.-W.F:P./Legis/96/14251,
dated 26-8-1996.---The North West Frontier Province Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial assembly of the
North-West Frontier Porvince on the 6th August, 1996 and assented to by
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 22nd August, 1996, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and commencement.---This Act may be called the North
West Frontier Province Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2),It shall come into force at
once.

3. Amendment of section 169 of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979.0-- In

(i) the existing section shall be
re-numbered as subsection (1) of that section and for the proviso appearing

4. Amendment of Third Schedule to N.-W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979.---In
the said Ordinance, in the Third Schedule,--
(i) in Part I, after the existing
entry at serial No. 22-A the following new entries shall be inserted, namely:
"22-B.
Fixing any bill, notice, placard or other paper or means of the advertisement
against or upon any building, wall or place other than the places fixed for the
purpose by a Local Council.
22-C. Any
writing or painting on a building, wall or place.
22-D.

the entries at serial numbers 50, 51 and 52 shall be deleted.
